visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person's hand reaches out and slides open a light-colored vertical wooden slatted door, revealing a glimpse of a modern Japanese restaurant interior with warm lighting and a long wooden counter. The perspective is from the doorway looking in. (2) Inside the restaurant, a chef dressed in a black professional uniform is seen behind a wooden sushi counter. He is meticulously arranging large slices of raw fish, including tuna and salmon, into a rectangular metal prep tray. (3) The chef uses a long, traditional Japanese knife to thin-slice a piece of pale white fish on a large wooden cutting board. The lighting is focused and bright on the food preparation area, emphasizing the texture of the fish. (4) A rapid montage of close-up shots showcases various dishes: a fresh oyster garnished with pink roe, a delicate cup of sea urchin topped with a small piece of gold leaf, and a platter featuring a cooked red lobster with rich green roe. (5) Hands are seen using wooden chopsticks to lift pieces of lobster meat and squeeze fresh lemon juice over a piece of grilled fish. The camera captures the glistening texture of the sauces and the steam rising from the cooked dishes. (6) A series of sushi presentations are shown, featuring salmon with ikura, fatty tuna with a dab of wasabi, and a seared piece of wagyu beef glazed with a dark, savory sauce. Each piece is placed on a textured ceramic plate. (7) A bowl of clam soup is opened to reveal large, plump shellfish in a clear broth, followed by a simple dessert of sliced pineapple served in a black bowl with a gold fork. (8) The camera pans across the empty restaurant, showing the clean lines of the L-shaped wooden counter and black chairs, then transitions to a static shot of the restaurant's exterior entrance and street-side signage under natural daylight.
